title: Injection Moulding Machine Library
scope: Manufacturer, model, controller, manual, service-document and verified-specification registry for injection moulding machines.

verification_levels.verified: Exact model or exact document identity verified from a primary or directly matching source.
verification_levels.strong_match: Strong family/controller match, but exact hardware revision is not independently confirmed.
verification_levels.reference_only: Useful adjacent documentation; not safe to treat as the exact machine manual.
verification_levels.missing: Document known or strongly expected to exist but not yet located.

manufacturers.name: Ningbo Hwamda Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

models.generation_note: Original M6 generation. Do not substitute HMD400M6-S servo documentation unless the machine is independently identified as -S.

manufacture_year.evidence_note: The exact machine year is unknown. The exact HMD400M6 model is documented in historical market records by 2008; a 2007-era Hwamda supplier listing also identifies the model.

controller.host_note: AK668 documentation exists for M8M/M10M, but the photographed front panel alone does not prove AK668 is fitted.

manuals.title: HMD M6 Series Technical Data Pack
manuals.notes: 18-page family technical-data pack. HMD400M6 data is on the HMD400M6 section; this is not the full operation/service manual.

manuals.title: Techmation M8M / M10M HMI Controller & Software Manual
manuals.notes: Direct 80-page Techmation M8M/M10M Standard HMI Controller & Software Manual. The photographed panel strongly matches this HMI family. The manual itself says machine safety, general operation and maintenance require the machine manufacturer's manual; exact controller host/revision remains unconfirmed.

manuals.title: AK668 / M8M / M10M HMI Controller & Software Manual
manuals.notes: Do not promote this to exact-controller status until AK668 hardware is independently confirmed.

manuals.title: Techmation TECH2 Series Installation Manual
manuals.notes: Useful generic Techmation hardware reference. Not the HMD400M6 OEM electrical drawing.

wanted_documents.title: Hwamda HMD400M6 / M6 operation and maintenance manual

sources.title: 2008 plastic manufacturing equipment auction listing
supports: HMD400M6 documented in field use by 2008

research_log.summary: Fresh multi-language search repeated across exact-model, service manual, electrical schematic, hydraulic schematic, Chinese manual/drawing terms, manual repositories, GitHub code search and historical product listings. No authenticated full HMD400M6 OEM service/drawing pack was located.

Verified a direct 80-page M8M/M10M Standard HMI Controller & Software Manual PDF. It covers operations, panel keys/screens, I/O diagnostics/reassignment, machine diagnostics, machine-set data, DA adjustment and alarms, while explicitly requiring the machine manufacturer's manual for machine safety/general operation/maintenance. Exact HMD400M6 OEM service/drawing pack still not found.
